g.text: Candidate migration drill before the only production writer is replaced
Read production health, image id and revision
Run PRAGMA quick_check and capture family/global row counts
Copy snapshot to isolated drill directory
Run candidate migrations against copy only
Stop public tunnel, command bot and alert bot
Create final snapshot and record previous image
Repeat candidate migration drill on final copy
health + authenticated read + row counts pass?
Keep final snapshot for retention window
Resume command bot, alert bot and public tunnel
Resume previous command bot, alert bot and public tunnel
Release gate / final snapshot + previous image are the rollback point
